content.en: Researchers have been exploring various ways to improve the efficiency and productivity of crowdsourcing tasks. They have developed algorithms that can identify and select qualified workers, optimize task assignments, improve collective productivity, utilize worker reputation information, allocate specialized tasks, personalize task composition, improve task accuracy and reduce latency, share risks and rewards, ensure quality-aware task assignment, optimize microtask assignment, shift to a post-Taylorism crowdsourcing model, achieve stable task assignment, perform online task scheduling, consider social relationships in task assignment, perform accurate inference of crowdsourcing properties, form crowdsourcing teams, and build decision support systems for crowd workers. These algorithms aim to make crowdsourcing more effective and beneficial for both workers and requesters.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige måder at forbedre effektiviteten og produktiviteten af crowdsourcing-opgaver. De har udviklet algoritmer, der kan identificere og vælge kvalificerede arbejdstagere, optimere opgavefordelinger, forbedre kollektiv produktivitet, udnytte arbejdstageres omdømmeinformation, tildele specialiserede opgaver, personalisere opgavekomposition, forbedre opgavepræcision og reducere ventetid, dele risici og belønninger, sikre kvalitetsbevidst opgavefordeling, optimere mikroopgavefordeling, skifte til en post-Taylorism crowdsourcing-model, opnå stabil opgavefordeling, udføre online opgaveplanlægning, tage sociale relationer i betragtning ved opgavefordeling, udføre nøjagtig inferens af crowdsourcing-egenskaber, danne crowdsourcing-teams og bygge beslutningsstøttesystemer for crowdarbejdere. Disse algoritmer har til formål at gøre crowdsourcing mere effektivt og gavnligt for både arbejdstagere og anmodere.

critic.en: So now we're "optimizing" how to exploit people in the gig economy. We disguise precariousness as efficiency! Do these algorithms have a consciousness?
critic.da: "Improve collective productivity," "utilize worker reputation," "ensure quality-aware task assignment"... Er det, vi har brug for, virkelig at gøre crowdsourcing mere "effektiv"? Vi skal spørge os selv, om det er en god idé at optimere et system, der allerede nu udnyttes til at betale så lavt, som overhovedet muligt.

potential.en: I really believe that technology and digitalization have the power to revolutionize the way we work and collaborate. Crowdsourcing is a great example of how we can use algorithms to optimize tasks and make them more efficient. By leveraging the collective intelligence of a diverse group of people, we can achieve outcomes that would be impossible for any individual or traditional organization. I'm excited to see how researchers continue to develop and refine these algorithms, and I'm confident that they will have a positive impact on the future of work.
potential.da: Wow, sikke en udvikling! Algoritmerne, der bliver skabt til at optimere crowdsourcing, viser virkelig potentialet i samarbejde og digitalisering. Jeg synes, det er fascinerende, hvordan man kan anvende teknologien til at skabe mere orden, retfærdighed og effektivitet i arbejdet for den store mængde af frivilige, freelance medhjælpere. Vi bringer ind til at levere input og samtidigt få gavn af det fælles samarbejde. Det bliver sjovt at se, hvordan disse redskaber vil ændre og forbedre crowdsourcing-platforme i fremtiden!
